summary: Apply one authorised, revision-bound shared or local workspace policy decision.

writes.when: the authorised decision explicitly completes the matching readiness identity

steps.description: Validate authority, setup identity, revision, scope, fields, and values before a preservation-oriented bounded update.
Emit the compact owner, revision, and effect result.

guards: Accept only agentic-workspace/config-policy-decision/v1 structured input with explicit authority and scope.
Reject stale config revisions or setup identities before writing.
Allow only the bounded policy inventory; module lifecycle and other owners remain separate.
Preserve comments and unknown fields while updating only admitted scalar or compact concern-list assignments.
Never promote credentials, secrets, or absolute machine paths into shared config.
Complete readiness only through a separate no-change decision whose setup identity, current capability basis, and semantic concern receipt map exactly match recomputed repository state.
Treat setup defer, optional suppression, and resume as local revision-bound disposition changes; they never mark repository readiness current and completion removes their local residue.
proof: shared and local mutation fixtures preserve unrelated comments and fields
stale revision and identity fixtures reject without writes
generated Python and TypeScript callables expose equivalent result fields

skill.instruction_summary: Use only after setup judgment has produced an authorised structured decision and exact current revisions.

ir_plan.summary: A single domain primitive owns the bounded preservation-oriented config mutation; portable output.emit owns rendering.

steps.description: Resolve and validate the target root.
Apply the authorised revision-bound bounded policy decision.
